# DSH Rust (dsh-rust) — Agent Harness

> A contract-first Rust implementation of DeepSeek Harness.
> Layered Cargo workspace with runnable HTTP/SSE, a minimal ReAct loop and built-in tools.

Key capabilities (v0.2.1):
- HTTP service: `GET /health`, `POST /api/agent/message`, `POST /api/agent/stream`, `POST /api/agent/cancel`, `GET /api/sessions/{sessionId}/events`
- Minimal ReAct loop: model step -> tool call -> observation -> next step -> stop (default max 8 steps)
- Persistence: sessions, messages, events and runs in SQLite (`DSH_DB_PATH`); `DSH_STORE=memory` is the rollback path
- Continuation: a restarted process keeps history for the same `sessionId`; event `seq` continues across restarts
- Replay: events paged by `seq` via `afterSeq` / `limit` (default 200, max 1000)
- Models: scriptable FakeModel (default); DeepSeek Chat Completions behind feature `deepseek`
- Tools: `echo`, `clock`, `read_file` (workspace sandbox, UTF-8, 256 KiB, 5s timeout)
- SSE: `chunk` / `tool_call` / `done` / `error`; increasing seq, single terminal event, keepalive excluded, byte budget ends with `stream_budget_exceeded`
- Cancellation: cancel by `runId` or `agentId`; idempotent after completion
- Contract replay: 10 fixtures (handwritten + runtime-exported); openapi generated and CI-checked

Tech stack: Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, Axum 0.8, Tokio 1, serde/serde_json, rusqlite 0.40 (bundled), tracing
Version: 0.2.1
Contract version: 1.0.0-draft.1
Upstream: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
Java counterpart: https://github.com/linlannet/dsh-java

Build: `cargo build --workspace`
Test:  `cargo test --workspace --all-features`
Run:   `cargo run -p dsh-runtime`
Lint:  `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
Contracts: `node contracts/tools/validate.mjs`
OpenAPI: `node contracts/tools/generate-openapi.mjs --check`

Crate map:
- crates/dsh-types   contract value objects, IDs, error model, SessionEvent, timestamps
- crates/dsh-domain  session aggregate, model/tool/event-log ports, run events
- crates/dsh-case    ReAct orchestration, event buffering, tool/run registries, blocking bridge
- crates/dsh-http    Axum routes, DTOs, error mapping, SSE encoding with byte budget
- crates/dsh-infra   FakeModel/DeepSeek, tools, sandbox, SQLite store and in-memory stores
- apps/dsh-runtime   executable entry and configuration
- contracts/         v1 schemas/openapi, fixtures, policy, tools

Configuration (env):
`DSH_BIND_ADDR`, `DSH_MODEL` (fake|deepseek), `DSH_FAKE_SCRIPT` (echo|tool), `DSH_MAX_STEPS`,
`DSH_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS`, `DSH_MODEL_TIMEOUT_MS`, `DSH_WORKSPACE_ROOT`,
`DSH_READ_FILE_MAX_BYTES`, `DSH_MODEL_BASE_URL`, `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`,
`DSH_STORE` (sqlite|memory), `DSH_DB_PATH`, `DSH_STREAM_BUDGET_BYTES`.

Persistence rules:
- DDL only in `contracts/v1/persistence/migrations/`; the store applies them idempotently at startup
- All event writes go through `dsh_domain::EventLog` (`append` / `append_many`); never hand-roll `seq`
- Session and event ports are synchronous; `dsh-case` bridges them with `spawn_blocking`
- `rusqlite` stays inside `dsh-infra` and pinned to 0.40 (MSRV 1.85)

Docs:
- README.md / README.en.md
- docs/0.1.0/, docs/0.2.0/, docs/0.2.1/ (spec, design, tasks, release notes)
- contracts/README.md
- AGENTS.md

Not included yet: plugin host, approvals, authentication, multi-tenancy.
